operating_point.notes: Simple quantum defect = 1 - lambda_p/lambda_l. Full heat model must also include ETU, nonradiative relaxation and radiative escape.

composition.notes: Rupp validation value. For future inhomogeneous simulations, replace scalar density by N_Ho(x,y,z).

preferred_dispersion_model.name: Zelmon two-pole Sellmeier for undoped YAG at ~21 C

notes: These are the values used in the Rupp 1.1 at.% Ho:YAG validation simulation.
Do not assume the ETU/cross-relaxation coefficients are concentration-independent over large Ho concentration changes.
For the first narrowband CW implementation, only cross sections at pump and laser wavelengths are required.

temperature_dependent_absorption.implementation_note: Use the full published spectrum when broadband pump modelling is introduced; peak table is sufficient for validation near the 1908 nm operating point.

source.author: M. Rupp
source.title: Multi-Physics Simulation of High-Power Solid-State Laser Systems

hot_cross_section_measurements.observation: Measured pump absorption and laser emission cross sections both decrease as temperature increases.
hot_cross_section_measurements.model_method: Linear interpolation in wavelength and temperature for sigma_a,e(lambda,T).
hot_cross_section_measurements.data_availability: Curves are published graphically; raw numerical arrays were not located in the public indexed material.
hot_cross_section_measurements.implementation_policy: Keep the 2023 validation constants for baseline reproduction. Add digitized/interpolated hot curves before high-fidelity Stage 5/8 thermal feedback.

stark_levels.implementation_dataset_provenance: Legacy Ho:YAG level set reproduced in Abdolvand thesis and earlier literature; suitable for initial manifold bookkeeping.
stark_levels.modern_reference_warning: Walsh, Grew & Barnes (2006) remeasured Ho:YAG Stark levels and reported discrepancies with some earlier assignments. Do not treat the legacy list as a definitive high-resolution spectroscopy dataset.
stark_levels.centroid_warning: The centroid wavelengths are derived fallback estimates only. Rupp's heat equation requires average photon energies; use measured/line-strength-weighted branch spectra when available rather than silently treating these centroids as exact.

linear_thermal_expansion_K-1.source: Wynne, Daneu, Fan, Applied Optics 38, 3282 (1999), YAG at ~300 K
linear_thermal_expansion_K-1.reason: Rupp uses alpha in the thermo-mechanical equations but does not list alpha in Appendix A.

debye_model.source: Rupp 2025 thesis, section 4 thermal model; YAG Debye temperature supported by Aggarwal et al.
debye_model.heat_capacity_equation: Cp(T) = Cmax * fD(T), with the Debye integral fD defined in Rupp Eq. 4.72
debye_model.conductivity_equation: k(T) = k(T0)*Cp(T)*gD(T0)/(Cp(T0)*gD(T)), with gD defined in Rupp Eq. 4.74
debye_model.policy: Use the original constant Cp=680 J/(kg K), k=14 W/(m K) to reproduce the 2023 validation first; enable the Debye model for the extended thermal simulation.

yag_thermo_optic_632p8nm.equation: dn/dT = M0 + M1*T + M2*T^2 + M3*T^3, T in kelvin
yag_thermo_optic_632p8nm.warning: dn/dT is wavelength dependent and decreases with increasing wavelength. Do not directly claim this polynomial is exact at 2.09 um. For the first 2-um model retain the Rupp 9.1e-6 K^-1 baseline or use only the relative temperature trend until direct 2-um data are validated.

photoelastic_stress_optic.notes: Values/formulas copied from Rupp Appendix A for the chosen <111> cut convention.

cooling_boundary_defaults_from_validatio.notes: Keep these separate from bulk thermal conductivity. They represent the validation mount/boundary model.

reference_validation_setup.crystal_endfaces: AR coated at pump and laser wavelengths

source.authors: N. P. Barnes, B. M. Walsh, E. D. Filer
source.title: Ho:Ho upconversion: applications to Ho lasers

auxiliary_concentration_dependence_data.warning: P77 is a total Ho:Ho upconversion parameter and is not automatically identical to each split k_I7_to_I5 or k_I7_to_I6 coefficient in the Rupp four-manifold model. Use as validation/concentration-dependence evidence, not a drop-in replacement.

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Raw numerical 300-500 K sigma_a(lambda,T) and sigma_e(lambda,T) arrays
known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.mitigation: Rupp 2025 Fig. 4.19 provides measured curves and the interpolation method; digitize once Stage 5 needs hot gain feedback.

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Line-strength-weighted average photon energy for every spontaneous heat-loss branch
known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.mitigation: Stark manifolds are now stored and centroid fallbacks are provided; replace with measured/branch-weighted means for final Stage 5 validation.

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Validated concentration dependence for each split ETU/cross-relaxation coefficient
known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.mitigation: Use the Rupp 1.1 at.% coefficients for small spatial Ho variations; use measured total P77 concentration trend only as a constraint, not as a direct substitute.

known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.item: Background absorption and AR coating loss
known_gaps_before_high_fidelity_model.mitigation: Keep configurable and determine from the physical crystal/coating used.

implementation_policy.baseline_mode: reproduce Rupp 1.1 at.% operating point first
implementation_policy.recommended_first_pass: Keep spectroscopic coefficients fixed at Rupp values while varying N_Ho spatially by modest amounts; add concentration-dependent ETU only after baseline validation.
implementation_policy.revision_0_1: Stage 0.1 resolves the main literature gaps. Stage 1-4 can proceed with fixed 2023 baseline spectroscopy. Stage 5 should enable Debye thermal properties; high-fidelity hot gain should use digitized Rupp 2025 sigma(lambda,T) curves.

sample_specific_losses.reason: No defensible universal values exist: parasitic absorption depends on crystal quality/impurities, and AR loss depends on the deposited coating. The Rupp validation paper states AR-coated faces but does not give a coating reflectivity.
sample_specific_losses.calibration: Measure passive transmission/reflectance of the actual sample and fit these separately from Ho resonant absorption.
